title: Security hunt findings: IoT fail-open, logistics overload, warranty/NCR/EOT, path traversal
body: ## Summary Security research hunt across Document-Control, Closeout, Field-Ops, Analytics, Innovative IoT/logistics, Book parsers, Curated email, and Insights remaining skills. ## Findings (1 CRITICAL + 7 HIGH) - **CRITICAL** `sensor-data-aggregator`: SUSPECT quality / empty thresholds fail-open suppress safety alerts - **HIGH** `environmental-monitoring`: missing/TWA-only → COMPLIANT - **HIGH** `site-logistics-optimization`: crane capacity ignored - **HIGH** `warranty-tracker`: expiring alert set always empty - **HIGH** `quality-control-workflow`: NCR auto-ACCEPTED + verify without evidence - **HIGH** `schedule-delay-analyzer`: forged EOT claims - **HIGH** `email-construction`: attachment path arbitrary file read - **HIGH** `csv-handler`: `split_csv` path traversal ## Artifacts - `DDC_Skills_for_AI_Agents_in_Construction---flagged-vulnerabilities-15.json` - `DDC_Skills_doc-iot-logistics-findings-15.json` Run: https://cursor.com/agents/bc-fe2bfb45-a089-5fda-8b95-7b353e079d14
